name: Clarke County, AL
findings: Clarke County has 40 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Clarke County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Clarke County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 6 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
